Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Reeza Hendricks and Temba Bavuma will open the batting for South Africa. Bhuvneshwar Kumar will begin with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! India's bowling unit has not performed at its best. But they need to defend this total to keep the series alive. South Africa have been clinical with chasing down targets so far. Who will come out on top in this game? We will find out. An intriguing second half of the game coming up. Stay tuned!

Ruturaj Gaikwad is down for a chat. He says it's a tricky wicket, there was extra bounce, and the slower ones were holding a little bit. He feels the wicket will get better and thinks they are 10-15 runs short. Shares that they need to bowl slow and on hard lengths. Says they need to back themselves, T20I is a tricky game but they have to bat with intent and play with a positive mind.

South Africa bowlers were taken to the cleaners at the start but fought their way back strongly. They put a lid on the run flow in the middle overs and at the fag end of the innings. They gave away just over 50 runs in the last 7 overs. At one stage a target of 200 was looking possible, but the visitors have done well to keep it well under 200. Dwaine Pretorius was the pick of the bowlers, he grabbed two wickets and was economical as well, while Tabraiz Shamsi and Kagiso Rabada grabbed a wicket each.

After being put into bat first Ishan Kishan and Ruturaj Gaikwad scored runs freely, the latter being the aggressor of the two. They put 57 runs together at the end of the Powerplay. Ishan Kishan then decided to shift gears. Both the openers notched up their half-centuries. However, after putting a stand of 97 runs, Ruturaj Gaikwad perished soon in the 10th over, and India did lose a few wickets in the middle phase. The runs for them also had dried up, but Hardik Pandya's cameo, in the end, helped India reach 179. India would be disappointed at the end, and would feel they probably fell short of 20 runs here!

A good fight back from South Africa! It's been a good recovery from the visitors. They would be pleased with their effort with the ball here. While India would be gutted with the target they have set after getting off to a blistering start. Hardik Pandya's unbeaten 31, in the end, has helped India set a target of 180.
Two runs then! A low full toss on middle. Pandya gets a leading edge as he tries to work on the leg side. It rolls to long off for a brace. Indian finish on 179 for 5.
Too full and around off. Pandya jams it out to point. No run taken. Pandya wants to keep the strike for the final ball.

FOUR! Wayne Parnell has to change his plans here! He is failing his yorkers and is serving some freebies to a very good finisher. This is a low full toss, on middle. Pandya muscles it over extra cover for a boundary.
Fails to execute a yorker and serves a low full toss on middle, worked to long on for a single.
Yorker this time, on off. Pandya jams it out to covers for a single.
FOUR! Perfect start to the over for India! Wayne Parnell attempts another yorker but overpitches it, in the slot. Pandya whips it to deep mid-wicket, well wide of the fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! Crucial runs! On a length and around off. Patel rocks on the back foot quickly and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
In the air and falls safely! Another well-directed bumper on middle and slower. Pandya mistimes his pull and it balloons in the air and falls safely in front of the running long on fielder. A single.
FOUR! edged! Short of a length and outside off. Pandya tries to hook it away but gets a top edge to third man for a boundary.
Axar Patel is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A very full ball, on middle. Dinesh Karthik shuffles across and goes for a pre-meditated scoop but miscues it completely and Wayne Parnell at short third man takes a simple catch. Indian have lost the plot here.
Commentary.Howout: c Wayne Parnell b Kagiso Rabada

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, outside off, slower and outside off. Pandya punches it to covers for a single.
A slower ball, outside off. Karthik dabs it to backward point for a single.
Parnell misses his yorker again, a full toss on middle. Karthik whips it to deep square leg for a single.
Another full toss on middle, worked to deep mid-wicket for one more.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! A full toss, angling outside off. Pandya punches through the diving cover fielder for a boundary.
Short of a length and on off. Karthik pulls it off the upper half of the bat and to mid-wicket for a single.
Full again on middle. Pandya turns it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pitched up, around off. Pandya pushes it to covers.
A length ball, outside off. Karthik tries to reverse-hit it but misses. A stifled appeal follows but nothing from the umpire.
Slightly shorter but slower again, Pandya pulls it to cow corner for one.
A slower length ball, outside off, pulled away to deep square leg for a single.
Too full and on leg. Pandya nudges it to square leg for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Pandya punches it to covers.
On a length and on middle, it nips back in. Karthik bunts it to square leg for one.
Full and on middle. DK drills it to long on for a single.
Dinesh Karthik walks out to the middle.

OUT! TAKEN! Temba Bavuma shows everyone how to take a catch! This is full and angling around middle and off. Pant tries to play across the angle and ends up slicing it, high and to covers where Temba Bavuma backpedals and holds onto it. Pant fails to impact again.
Commentary.Howout: c Temba Bavuma b Dwaine Pretorius

Commentary.Commentary: In the air and safe! On a length and outside off. Pandya tries to cut it hard but hits it aerially and over backward point where it drops safely. A single.
On middle, Pant works it to long on for a single.
Around off, length and it is hit to covers for a single.

DROPPED! Ohh..no! Rassie van der Dussen now! Both the batters have got a life now! Dwaine Pretorius again bowls it slower and way outside off, asking Pant to reach and he does so by throwing his bat at it. He mistimes it and the ball flies to deep point where Rassie van der Dussen runs forward and fails to take it low.
Wide! Slower but way outside off. Left alone.
Slightly short, around off. Pant works it through covers for one.
Flatter and outside off. Pandya taps it to cover for a single.
Around off, pushed to covers.

DROPPED! David Miller, you don't often see that guy dropping it. Floats it full and around off. Pandya swings across but slices it, high in the air and to long off where Miller has enough time to settle under it but still lets it through his hands. Two runs.  Tabraiz Shamsi cannot believe it!
Shorter and outside off. Pant cuts it hard to deep cover for a single.

A stumping appeal! Pant looks confident here! UltraEdge shows nothing on it!  The replay shows Pant's back foot was grounded. A fuller ball, outside off and spinning away. Pant looks to sweep it but misses and the keeper is quick to whip the bails off. Pant was in though.
A single as Pant drills this full ball to long on.
Length ball, outside off, slower, it is pushed to long off for a single.
Hardik Pandya comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! This is a good comeback from South Africa! A full ball, outside off, was the off-cutter. Kishan loses his balance as he tries to go over deep extra covers but fails to power it and Reeza Hendricks there takes it with ease. Two new batters are in the crease for India now.
Commentary.Howout: c Reeza Hendricks b Dwaine Pretorius

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on middle, Pant tucks it to deep square leg for one.
Slower one, angling on middle. Kishan whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off. Kishan carves it to covers.
Wide! Sees Kishan shuffling across and serves it way outside off, over the tramline and it is called a wide.
Rishabh Pant comes in.

OUT! TAKEN! This time Iyer has to go! Shamsi flights this one nicely, on a length and around middle. Iyer gets on his knee to sweep it but mistimes it to square leg where Anrich Nortje, inside the ring, times his jump perfectly and takes it over his head. India losing their momentum here.
Commentary.Howout: c Anrich Nortje b Tabraiz Shamsi

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and outside off, punched to covers.

Tossed up, on a length and around leg, spinning away from the right-hander. Shreyas Iyer gets low to sweep but gets some gloves on it before getting rapped on the pads. A huge shout for LBW and up goes the finger! Shreyas Iyer reviews it. UltraEdge shows a spike as it went past the gloves. Not out it is.
On middle, swept hard but straight to deep square leg for a single.
Tad short and outside off, cut to deep point for one.
SIX! Second one for Iyer! A loopy ball, full and around off. Iyer comes down the track and muscles it over long off for a biggie.
FOUR! Fine, very fine! That brings up fifty as well for Ishan Kishan! He is batting superbly here! Slightly short and around off. Kishan hangs back and dabs it past short third man for a boundary.
SIX! All the way! This is full and on off. Kishan makes room and lofts it over wide of long off for a beautiful six.
FOUR! Smacked away! A low full toss, around leg. Kishan clears his front leg and gets low to sweep it away to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
A single as this is hit to long on.
Tossed up, slower and on middle. Iyer gets back and blocks it out.
Full and across, wide of off. Kishan smashes it to long off for a single.
Length and outside off, punched to covers.

SIX! EDGED AWAY! Another good short ball from on middle. Iyer moves across on the off side and looks to pull but gets a top edge and it goes over long leg for a biggie. Streaky way to get off the mark.
A length ball, around off, Iyer shuffles across and plays it back to the bowler.
Length ball, around off. Kept out.
Shorter and on middle. Kishan looks to pull but gets big on him and he mistimes his hit to deep mid-wicket where it falls in between two converging players. A single.
Length and on off. Kishan pushes it to covers.

DRINKS! India are off to a brilliant start and just what they wanted in this do-or-die. A good set up for the players following next to post a huge total. South Africa will look for more wickets. Shreyas Iyer is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Ruturaj Gaikwad has given away his wicket here! Maharaj nicely tosses it up, full and on middle, a hint of away spin there. Gaikwad tries to play at long on but plays off the outer half of the bat and it lobs to Maharaj who dives forward and holds onto it. A fine innings from Gaikwad comes to an end. He has given a superb start here.
Shorter, outside off, stays low, cut to deep point for a couple.
Tossed up, around leg. Gaikwad hangs back and slaps it hard but straight to short fine leg.
Flatter and outside off. Kishan cuts it past point for a single. He slips while running back for the second. So, just a single.
Around middle, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! It is raining boundaries here at Vizag! Full, flighted and on middle. Gaikwad makes room and goes inside-out over covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Kishan gets the better of Shamsi! Tossed up, sliding down the leg side. Kishan sweeps it hard and hits it well wide of the fielder in the deep for a boundary.
Kishan will feel he missed out there! A full toss on middle. Kishan reverse sweeps it straight to point. Some words exchanged between Kishan and Shamsi. This should be interesting!
SIX! BANG! Full and on off. Kishan slog-sweeps it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Fifty for Gaikwad! A maiden fifty for him! A memorable knock and also playing at a very good rate! Full and on middle, worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower through the air, around middle, hit to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, quicker and on middle. Gaikwad comes down the track and forces it to long on for a single.
Gaikwad will keep the strike! Slower again, on middle, drilled down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Luck with Gaikwad at the moment! Full ball, slower and outside off. Gaikwad tries to sweep it but gets a top edge, over the keeper and to fine leg for a boundary.
Full and on off, nudged to mid-wicket for a single.

Chance! Good effort from Rassie van der Dussen! A full ball, outside off. Kishan swings across but gets a top edge to deep point. Rassie van der Dussen runs in from deep and slides but fumbles to collect it. Was a hard one to catch it.
The DRS is back and running says the on-air commentator Murali Kartik.
On middle. Blocked out.
Length ball, tailing around off. Gaikwad drills it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Boundaries keep on flowing for India! They are motoring along nicely! This is full and on middle. Kishan reverse-hits it over point for a boundary.
A single as this full ball is hit to long on.
A freebie but only a single! Full and angling down the leg side. Kishan sweeps it in front of square on the leg side for a single.
This one is spinning onto the pads, tucked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off, swept to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and around off. Kishan works it past point for a couple of runs.
Tabraiz Shamsi is into the attack now.
A slower ball, full and on off, pushed to mid on. At the end of the Powerplay, India are on 57/0.
SIX! Tremendous shot! Full and following Gaikwad on the leg side. Gaikwad whacks it all the way over square leg for a biggie. Just over the fielder there.
Full and on middle, eased to mid on for a quick single.
The DRS is not working at the moment says the on-air commentator Murali Kartik.
Around leg, tucked behind square on the leg side for a single. 50 up...
Sliding on the pads. Gaikwad nudges it straight to mid-wicket.
Full and on off, pushed to covers for a single.
Good end to the over but the damage is already done! Hits the hard length, outside off. Gaikwad slashes at it but misses. 20 runs off the over.

FOUR! Make it five in five for Gaikwad! A length ball, outside off. Gaikwad tries to use the pace here as he steers it to short third man where Tabraiz Shamsi is slow to move across and it races again to the third man fence.
FOUR! Four fours in a row! Not a good follow up delivery from Nortje! This is full and on middle. Gaikwad flicks it past mid-wicket for a boundary.

FOUR! Three now but this one is a nasty delivery from Nortje! Nortje serves a well-directed bumper on middle. Gaikwad dances down the track and tries to ramp it away as he gets low but gets hit on the grill of the helmet and it races away to the third man fence. The physio is out to check Gaikwad quickly but he is fine.
FOUR! Two in a row! Feels like the nerves has settled for Gaikwad! Touch fuller and on middle. Gaikwad skips down and smashes it through mid on for another bundary.
FOUR! Nortje is greeted with a four! A length ball, outside off. Gaikwad cuts this 144 kph delivery past point for a boundary.
Anrich Nortje is into the attack.
A low full toss, around leg. Gaikwad drills it wide of long on for a single.
Fuller and on off. Kishan drives it nicely to mid off for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Kishan dabs it to deep backward point for a brace.
Short of a length is working for South Africa here! This is outside off and at a good pace as well. Kishan skips down and looks to heave it but misses.
Parnell serves a slower bumper and Kishan steps forward to pull it away to deep square leg. Anrich Nortje runs to his right and does well to cut it out. Two.
Around off on a length, pushed to covers.
On a length and around off. Kishan steps across to tuck it away but inner edges it to square leg for a single. 12 off the over.
Rabada hits the hard length, outside off. Gaikwad slices it past point for a single.
SIX! HAMMERED! Much better from Gaikwad! In the slot, fuller and Gaikwad flicks it away, over cow corner for a biggie.
Again mistimed here! Length and on middle. Gaikwad closes the face of the bat too early and gets a soft leading edge to covers.
FOUR! Streaky! Gaikwad is struggling a bit to time here! Full and on off. Gaikwad looks to drive but gets an inside edge and it goes through square leg for a boundary.
SWING AND A MISS! On a length and on top of off. Gaikwad comes down the track and swings across but fails to connect.
Around off, on a length. Kishan punches off the outer half of the bat and to point.
Finally, something off the pitch! This is on a length and outside off, hint of away shape. Kishan prods and looks to push but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length ball, on middle. Gaikwad is a touch late to his shot as he nudges it wide of mid on for a single.
Pulls his length forward a bit, around off, nudged to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Kishan continues to be the aggressor! Short of a length, around off. Kishan is fast on his pull shot as he hits it over mid-wicket for the first boundary off the innings.
A length ball, around middle and off. Kishan hits it back to the bowler.
Wayne Parnell to bowl from the other end.
Good first over then for the Proteas! Length ball, just outside off, not much width and Gaikwad punches it to cover-point.
Tight from Rabada! Length ball, just around off. Gaikwad hangs back and blocks it out.
Back of a length, outside off, extra bounce. Gaikwad punches it to covers.
Length ball around middle. Gaikwad nudges it behind square on the leg side for a brace. The ball has not done much till now.

Two runs! On a length and on off. Gaikwad tucks it to mid on and takes off for a single. Wayne Parnell there hits at the bowler's end and the ball goes past the man at mid off and the batters will get another run. India are underway.
Short of a length and outside off. Gaikwad gets on his toes and guides it to point.

We are all set for the action. The players are out in the middle. Ruturaj Gaikwad once again has an opportunity to show his skills, he walks along with Ishan Kishan. Kagiso Rabada to start with the ball. A do-or-die game for India. Let's play...

Anrich Nortje is up for a chat. He says it's nice to be together as a team after a long break. Adds that they are just focusing on the basics and executing the plan well. Shares that he still isn't feeling 100% but he is happy to get some game time. It's a new challenge to play in India and hopes to be ready for the next World Cup. Shares that he doesn't think there will be much change before this game and hopes to secure the series here. A massive game for them and the boys will come hard today.

South Africa (Unchanged playing XI) - Temba Bavuma (C), Reeza Hendricks, Dwaine Pretorius, Rassie van der Dussen, Heinrich Klaasen (WK), David Miller, Wayne Parnell, Kagiso Rabada, Keshav Maharaj, Anrich Nortje, Tabraiz Shamsi

India (Unchanged playing XI) - Ruturaj Gaikwad, Ishan Kishan, Shreyas Iyer, Rishabh Pant (C/WK), Hardik Pandya, Axar Patel, Dinesh Karthik, Harshal Patel, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Avesh Khan, Yuzvendra Chahal.

Rishabh Pant, the skipper of India says he would've bowled first as well. He is not thinking much about the toss. Shares that they are playing the same team. Informs the execution should be better and feels they will be fine after that. Adds that the wicket is soft underneath but a little bit better that the previous one.

Temba Bavuma, the captain of South Africa says they will bowl again. Adds that this pitch is different and they are expecting a good one to play. It has a different colour, has a yellowish tinge to it. Informs they are playing same team. Shares that they had good first two games and he is just telling the guys to improve more in all departments.
TOSS - South Africa have won the toss and they will BOWL first!
